notes: Stealer signed with a valid (stolen / purchased) code-signing certificate of an unrelated company, renamed chrome.exe and placed at the per-user Chrome install path. is_trusted_owner() matches browser stores by image *name* + 'not untrusted' (any valid signer), and on_net() treats any trusted-looking browser image as a browser (no ST-04 / ST-14).
